name: @useyolo/source-tencent-sports
description: Official Yolo source plugin: Tencent Sports' games as a library of events, played through built-in link playback

summary.en: A row of NBA games on your home screen: live while they are played, their replays after.
summary.zh: 首页多一行 NBA 比赛：比赛中看直播，结束后看回放。

privacy.en: Asks Tencent Sports for its schedule and each game's replays, from the home machine, without your account. Keeps nothing but caches. Games play through Web links, with its sign-in.
privacy.zh: 从家里的电脑向腾讯体育查询赛程和每场比赛的回放，不用你的账号。除缓存外不保存任何东西。比赛通过“网页链接”播放，使用它的登录。
